subject: Where has the old geomorph blogpost gone?

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: Where has the old geomorph blogpost gone?
parts:
Dear all,

I am so sorry for my simple question. I liked the old geomroph blogpost very much and the website provided a lot of useful information and detailed explanation on several critical functions in geomorph. I often need to refer to the website. However, I noted that the website no longer exists. May I know if there is a corresponding new website and is it possible for me to read again the contents in that old blospost?

Thank you very much!

Best regards,
Patrick

Dear Patrick, I think that all contents of old site are here: 

https://github.com/geomorphR/geomorph/wiki

Regards,

Alejo
